notes.title: Monster Stalker: Prologue v1.01 Update
notes.content:
Update descriptions:
1. Add rest spot before the hidden battle.
2. Fix the bug that teammate’s health bar value can be dragged.
3. Fix the bug that in “VS” page sometimes enemies block victory condition text. 
4. Fix the bug that if beat Test Body before it transforms, victory window not showed.
5. In Menu page, click “new game” button will need double confirmation in case misoperation. 
6. Adjust balance of some badge functions. 
7. Adjust balance of some card functions.
8. Adjust balance of some enemies.
9. Adjust prices of store cards and card delete function.
10. Adjust cash got from battles.
11. Adjust some reward cards got from battles.
12. Revise some card descriptions.
13. Fix some other bugs.

Because some bugs and experience issues connected to player’s previously saved data, I suggest to start a new game to experience the whole updates.  

Thank you for playing the game!

notes.title: Monster Stalker: Prologue Now Released!
notes.content:
Monster Stalker: Prologue is a turn-based card battle game. You can get cards, build your deck, and fight various monsters. Game now released!

Later I will collect player feedbacks and continue developing Monster Stalker, the formal version. Welcome to leave your reviews. You can also join our Discord by store page or follow me on twitter.

Hope Monster Stalker: Prologue brings you a good time!

notes.title: Recent Updates of Demo v0.7 and v0.9
notes.content:
Demo v0.7 and v0.9 updates include:

1. Added new artwork for 25 cards.

2. Added auto save feature. 

3. Improved Badge system.

4. Added game guide. 

5. Improved dashboard page menu UI.

6. Added support to Traditional Chinese.

7. Improved game story.

8. Some bug fix.

Have fun!

notes.title: Monster Stalker: Prologue joins Enter the Dragon Game Festival!
notes.content:
Enter the Dragon is a game festival that will introduce a bunch of good indie games from China. The festival will start in this weekend!
My livestream as part of Enter the Dragon is about to begin! [b]I will be streaming Monster Stalker: Prologue on the Enter the Dragon Steam event page, lasting for one hour. [/b]I will play the game demo and share future develop and publish plans with you. 
Streaming time: 10:00 PM(CET), 4:00 PM(ET), 1:00 PM(PT) on April 24, 4:00 AM(Beijing time) on April 25
I would love for you to join me. See you there!
